audience: Romanian small businesses that issue invoices and track stock in Facturis Online

useCases.title: List invoices for a period
useCases.text: List the invoices issued in a date range, with their totals. Dates use the dd-mm-yyyy format.

useCases.title: Check stock of a product
useCases.text: Find a product by its EAN barcode or SKU. Then read the stock card of a warehouse at a location.

useCases.title: Add a client before invoicing
useCases.text: List the clients first. Then create a client with its name, fiscal code and registration number.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for a client
useCases.text: Create a live invoice with its lines. Facturis numbers the invoice and sets its status to issued. The call is not retried.
